item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 4 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 4 #VISPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 05:00 AM 06 September 2026

Yellow Warning: #OccidentalMindoro(Lubang, Looc, Paluan, AbraDeIlog and Mamburao)
Associated Hazard: FLOODING IS POSSIBLE in low-lying areas and LANDSLIDES in mountainous areas.

Meanwhile, Light to Moderate with occasionally Heavy rains are expected over #OccidentalMindoro(SantaCruz, Sablayan, Calintaan, Rizal, SanJose and Magsaysay) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 08:00 AM Today.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 3 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #VISPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 02:00 AM 06 September 2026

Yellow Warning: #Palawan(Araceli, Dumaran, Taytay, ElNido and Linapacan)
Associated Hazard: FLOODING IS POSSIBLE in low-lying areas and LANDSLIDES in mountainous areas.

Meanwhile, Light to Moderate with occasionally Heavy rains are expected over #Palawan(Busuanga, Culion and PuertoPrincesaCity) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OccidentalMindoro, #Palawan(Coron, SanVicente, Roxas, Magsaysay, Cuyo and Agutaya) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 05:00 AM Today.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #VISPRSD
Issued at 04:27 AM 06 September 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Samar(Matuguinao) and #NegrosOriental(Basay) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Samar(Gandara, SanJorge), #NegrosOccidental(HinobaAn, Candoni) and #NegrosOriental(CityOfBayawan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #VISPRSD

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #OccidentalMindoro, #Palawan, #Iloilo, #Guimaras, #Antique, #Capiz, #Aklan, #NegrosOccidental, #NegrosOriental, #Cebu, #Bohol, #Siquijor, #Leyte, #SouthernLeyte, #Biliran, #EasternSamar and #Samar within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.
